raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 includes a 05:00 re-delivery of 338 transactions with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, e.g. 1768716261000, which is 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC and matches the original 02:00 copy. The cast fails on these values, and they would also double-count every row. The fix is to parse both timestamp formats and keep one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1"}}
